profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Boston Dynamics
profile.summary: I am a software engineer interested in the software side of cyber-physical systems - specifically for autonomous and robotics applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Atlas Systems Software

Building the most capable humanoid robot in the world.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Supported MITRE's various government sponsored R&D projects in the realm of GNSS/PNT as an embedded software engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in the planning domain for RR.AI's level 4 fixed route vehicle autonomy kit
- Solved a scalability issue by redesigning a component of the planning/prediction system

positions.title: Graduate Research Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a simulator in Python for a PVD process system allowing researchers to simulate MRAM wafer processing times given a recipe that allows for better optimization.
- Collaborated with researchers in the MRAM group to build simulator with desired functionality.

positions.title: IVALab Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Researched, in a small team, a benchmarking methodology to evaluate novel and existing hierarchical robot path planning algorithms in outdoor environments, simulating using ROS with Gazebo.
- Produced an abstract, semi-annual, and final research summary as part of my responsibilities as a SRC URP Scholar sponsored by Intel.
- Presented my team’s technical work to faculty in an end-of-the-year research competition, as well as to fellow students.

positions.title: Sensors and Intelligent Systems Lab Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Researched online predictive modeling of heat in bio-implant systems in small team with a faculty advisor and PhD mentor using MATLAB and system identification methods over the course of a year, focusing on brain implant situations.
- Presented my team’s technical work to faculty in an end-of-the-year research competition, as well as to fellow students.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an application for Emerson’s PK embedded controller running the QNX RTOS that will allow manufacturing test engineers to load, via FTP, and run test applications in volatile memory, saving the time spent flashing new images.
- Collaborated in a scrum team of 10, under the Agile SAFe framework, by participating in daily standups, creating user stories, and working them through the workflow. Also partook in sprint planning/retros, I&A’s, and PI planning.
- Presented and demoed my work to executives, engineers, and managers on the solution train, about 100 people, describing its use and cost saving benefits to Emerson.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a tool for Bell’s flight test software, with end-to-end ownership within an n-tier architecture (C#/XAML), that allows data reduction engineers to do their jobs more efficiently by automating a multi-step process in a comprehensive single tool.
- Created GUI and basic back-end setup for a tool in Bell’s flight test analysis software that displays categorized test data so that flight test engineers can quickly identify test instrumentation issues.
- Presented my technical work to over 40 fellow engineers and managers, describing its function and benefit to Bell.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Researched, as a part of a team of 12, various path planning algorithms to be used for a LiDAR mounted RC car.
- Successfully Implemented 360-degree 2D LiDAR using motor mounted sensor, with data output to be used for path planning.

courses.name: Advanced Programming Techniques for Engineering Applications

honors.title: Congressional Award Silver Medal
honors.description:
Planned and executed program requirements in Service, Personal Development, and Fitness.   

Scheduled and led a (3) day/ (2) night exploration trip in Peru (Machu Picchu).
honors.issuer: Issued by United States Congress · Dec 2016

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Organized and supervised a service project to restore a conservation area over 4 months. Raised over $1,000 in funds and services. Recruited and led over 30 volunteers to complete the project.

- Provided bi-weekly garden maintenance.

- Promoted STEM to underexposed kids through FIRST Robotics.
- Collaborated with a team of (30) students in order to build two competition ready, driver controlled robots.
- Qualified for World Championships both years.
- Worked after school and during weekends to develop prototypes, machine parts, and assemble robot.
